description: Verify USDG settlements on Robinhood Chain (4663) from chain Transfer logs. Give a payTo address to scan its inbound settlements (default window: the last 30,000 blocks; widen with windowBlocks), or a tx hash to verify one settlement. The chain is the source; a bounded window's silence is INCONCLUSIVE, never proof of never.

payTo.description: Recipient address (0x…) whose inbound USDG settlements to scan.

tx.description: A single transaction hash (0x…, 32 bytes) to verify instead.

windowBlocks.description: Optional scan depth in blocks back from chain head (default 30000).

name: flow_receipt_check
